explanation: Ranking prioritizes patches that address the core m_axis_tlast mismatch pattern observed at cycles 65, 66, 101, and 172. The top candidates either substitute m_axis_tlast signals directly (patch_2c8752251e37, patch_316ca7f541a1, patch_bdd445d05642 via m_axis_tlast_reg) or gate the trigger/output logic with m_axis_tready_int_reg (patch_fc89a2456871, patch_1bcf966a75b9), which controls when frame_ptr_reg advances and m_axis_tlast_int is asserted. Patch_b7c09269741f substitutes busy_reg with trigger, potentially correcting the idle/output handshake. The remaining patches adjust related data/valid/user signals but are less directly tied to the tlast failure signature.
